mission_restated.description: The mission in your own words, in one or two sentences. Used to check you understood it before any work starts.

strategy.description: One paragraph: the order you will work in and why that order is the cheapest way to be correct.

subtasks.description: Ordered, independently verifiable units of work. Each one must be small enough to finish in one or two turns.

goal.description: What must be true when this subtask is done. State the outcome, not the activity.

why.description: Why this is needed before the subtasks that depend on it.

inputs.description: Exact workspace-relative paths, loopback URLs or node ids this subtask needs loaded before it starts.

actions.description: The action types you expect to use. Declaring them is a commitment, not a reservation.

acceptance.description: Checks that decide done-ness, each one machine-verifiable from text: a command that exits 0, an HTTP response, a string present in a file or page. Never 'it looks right'.

depends_on.description: Ids of subtasks that must complete first.

estimated_turns.description: How many turns this should take. Above 3 means it is still too big; split it.

risk.description: How likely this is to fail or need rework.

open_questions.description: Things you could not determine from the given facts and will have to discover.

needs_more_context.description: True when you cannot plan without more of the workspace.

missing_snippets.description: Minimal repo-relative files needed before planning can proceed.
